body:
Goal: a /release-audit project skill for this repo (Claude Code, `.claude/skills/release-audit/`), ported from ../adlc/.claude/skills/release-audit + scripts/release-audit-{collect,synthesize,workflow}.mjs, made bespoke to antigravity-booster. It answers GO / GO-WITH-RISK / NO-GO before /release. The verdict is arithmetic over structured agent reports, never a model summary. Nothing is deleted: findings are demoted with a named reason.

Why bespoke: adlc audits one agent per npm package in a lockstep monorepo. Booster is ONE npm package that is also a native agy plugin installed from a git URL with no npm install, so the audit units are shipped SURFACES, not packages, and the mechanical probes are this repo's own integrity gates.

Deliverables:
1. scripts/release-audit-collect.mjs (Phase A). Exports: UNITS (a declared table, not discovery) with ids surface:cli, surface:scheduler, surface:adlc-gates, surface:policy-guard (kind hook), surface:mcp, surface:install, surface:vendor, surface:skills, surface:sidecar; each lists repo-relative dirs/files. inventory(), unitForPath(), routeIssue()/routeIssues() with tiers: path-mention (lib/, hooks/, mcp/, bin/, dist/, vendor/, sidecars/, skills/, commands/, agents/ paths), ticket-scope (.adlc/tickets/*.json scope globs via globPrefix), command-token (`agb <cmd>` in the title mapped by COMMAND_UNITS, exactly one unit), labels are NOT used for routing (this repo has only default GitHub labels). isEscalated(): label `bug` or `security`, or a `[P0]`/`[P1]` title marker. sweepBatches() size 12, always >= 1 batch. fetchIssues() via gh with ISSUE_FETCH_LIMIT 500, truncation and failures recorded as unconsultable. churnFor() per unit since the newest vX.Y.Z tag. probes(): git state; lockstep (plugin.json == package.json == package-lock root version, D11); vendoredDigests (computeVendoredDigests() from scripts/update-adlc-digests.mjs vs KNOWN_VENDORED_ADLC from lib/adlc-bridge.mjs); vendoredTarball (sha512 of vendor/cache/adlc-antigravity-<devDependencies version>.tgz == package-lock integrity for node_modules/@adlc/antigravity); bundleDrift (only when the tree is clean: `npm run build` then `git status --porcelain dist/ vendor/`; records rebuilt:true; a dirty tree records unconsultable); websiteGen (`node scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check` in website/); releaseDrift (classifyDrift from scripts/release-drift.mjs with npm dist-tags.latest, tags, bump age; `undetermined` is unconsultable); shellcheck on bin/*.sh when available else unconsultable. Every probe that cannot run is recorded in probes.unconsultable, never as clean. Flags: [version] --since <tag> --units a,b --skip-issues --workflow-args. Default version = next minor of package.json. Routing always runs against ALL units even when --units narrows the run.
2. scripts/release-audit-synthesize.mjs (Phase C). Port verbatim semantics: grounding (evidence verbatim in the cited file, path confined to the repo), dedupe, demotions (ungrounded/refuted/hollow/unasserted blocker test), unitCoverage, probeFindings with PROBE_SEVERITY {lockstep, vendoredDigests, vendoredTarball, bundleDrift, releaseDrift: BLOCKER; websiteGen, shellcheck: SHOULD-FIX}, computeVerdict fail-closed (absent --suite, red suite, no summary, missing unit, hollow unit => NO-GO; partial run capped at GO-WITH-RISK; untriaged or truncated issues named). SUITE_UNITS = suite:drift, suite:docs, suite:supply plus suite:issues:N shards. parseSuiteResult() reads node --test output in BOTH reporters: spec (`ℹ tests N`, `ℹ pass N`, `ℹ fail N`, failing names from `✖ name`) and TAP (`# tests N`, `# fail N`, `not ok N - name`); no summary => ran:false.
3. scripts/release-audit-workflow.mjs: builds the self-contained Workflow script from the single ```javascript fence in .claude/skills/release-audit/references/workflow-script.md by injecting INPUT_DOC at the `// <<INPUT_DOC>>` marker after `export const meta`; escapes `<`, U+2028, U+2029.
4. .claude/skills/release-audit/SKILL.md + references/workflow-script.md, force-added (`.claude/` is gitignored; precedent: .claude/release-profile.md). Prompts are booster-specific: failure classes in order false-green/fail-open (enforcement gates: rails-guard, policy guard hook, run-integrity, vendored adlc authentication, lock; audit gates may degrade but must say so), install/first-run (git-URL plugin install with no npm install, dist bundles built-ins only, files allowlist, hook-runner.sh/node-launcher.sh under a stripped GUI PATH, Node >= 22.19, bootstrap from the vendored tarball, migrate/rollback), undeclared breaking change (CLI flags/exit codes, MCP tool schema, hook verdict, plan.json/events schema, plugin contract), trust boundary (hook runs with ambient env on every tool call; overrides ignored when bundled; worktree hooks disabled; sandbox), secrets, data loss (run lock, migration snapshots, ticket store, worktrees), doc-claim (README/USAGE stubs, website/content, commands/*.md, SKILL.md), dependency (zero runtime deps; bundles contain only built-ins). The hook unit prompt covers fail-open vs wrongly-fail-closed, the 9 s watchdog, and `agy -p` deny-only. Blocker test: user_hits_it is phrased for `agy plugin install <git-url>` / `npm i -g antigravity-booster@<version>` / `agb migrate`. suite:drift covers dist vs source, vendor digests, website generated partials, plugin.json lockstep, hooks.json/mcp_config.json paths, commands/*.md vs CLI. suite:docs covers CHANGELOG, website/content claims, stubs, website/scripts/stale-claims.json. suite:supply covers devDeps pinning, zero runtime deps, publish.yml + .claude/release-profile.md (OIDC, npm-publish gate, no token), SHA-pinned actions, CODEOWNERS/rails-guard workflow, files allowlist, vendored tarball integrity.
5. Tests under test/ (flat, node --test): release-audit-collect.test.mjs, release-audit-synthesize.test.mjs, release-audit-workflow.test.mjs, release-audit-skill.test.mjs (fence parses as a workflow body inside the async wrapper; every agent() call passes a schema; suite ids in the fence match SUITE_UNITS; projection provides every field the prompts read; UNITS paths all exist in the repo; UNITS do not overlap). Probes are tested with injected `run`/readers, never a network.
6. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased: Added entry. .claude/release-profile.md prose: run /release-audit before /release. website/content/docs/project/releasing.mdx: one paragraph on the readiness audit (then regenerate website partials: `cd website && node scripts/gen-reference.mjs`).

Constraints: do not touch lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs, .adlc/config.json, CODEOWNERS. Scripts live flat in scripts/ and are NOT in package.json files (not shipped). Importing lib/adlc-bridge.mjs unbundled is fine (tests already do). No new dependencies.

Acceptance criteria, each with its verifying command:
A. `npm test` passes with the four new test files included: `node --test test/release-audit-*.test.mjs` exits 0.
B. `node scripts/release-audit-collect.mjs --skip-issues | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));if(d.unitCount!==9)process.exit(1);console.log(d.units.map(u=>u.id).join(' '))"` prints the nine surface ids.
C. `node scripts/release-audit-collect.mjs --skip-issues --workflow-args > w.json && node scripts/release-audit-workflow.mjs --input w.json --out wf.mjs` exits 0 and `node --check` is not applicable (workflow body); the skill test compiles the fence inside the async wrapper.
D. A synthesize run with `--reports` from a fixture missing one surface exits 2 (NO-GO); with every unit reporting and a green suite log it exits 0.
E. `npm run coverage:check` still passes (scripts/ is counted).
F. `adlc rails-guard --base main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs` reports the rails untouched.
title: Port adlc's /release-audit skill into booster as a surface-based production-readiness audit
